claim_scope: frozen deterministic CPU float64 eager PyTorch workloads declared by pytorch-autograd-training-lineage-v1
excluded_interpretations: arbitrary PyTorch programs outside the frozen profile
gradient_value_dependency_definition: the dependency tensor is produced or registered in the actual forward or checkpoint recomputation
the real PyTorch backward retrieves or uses its corresponding saved tensor, or the dependency is a replayable registered source
at least one frozen one-at-a-time intervention changes the normalized target-gradient value while program, graph topology, other sources and other saved tensors remain fixed
the relation is not derived from a handwritten operation-specific derivative rule

semantic_distinctions.actual_participation: A source or intermediate result actually occurs in the generation chain; numerical gradient influence is not required.
semantic_distinctions.gradient_for_leaf: Identifies the leaf tensor for which a gradient was produced; it does not identify values used to compute that gradient.
semantic_distinctions.gradient_value_dependency: A real backward-used saved value or replayable registered source whose isolated frozen intervention changes a concrete target gradient.
